label: Product shot · Qwen Image 2.1
blurb: Puts the product from Image 1 in a new scene, lit like an ad. The product itself is kept exactly.
source: ComfyUI template image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit (prompt enhancer left out)
tips: Describe the surface it stands on and the light.
Plain-background product photos keep logos sharpest.

inputs.label: Product
inputs.hint: A clear photo of the product, ideally on a plain background.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: Place the product from <image1> in a new scene: on wet black rocks by a waterfall, misty morning. Reproduce the product exactly: shape, proportions, color, materials, logos and text. Light it to match the scene, with realistic contact shadows and reflections, like a professional advertising photo.
